newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Horse Racing-What A Question in form ahead of Asco.
newsitem.headline: Horse Racing-What A Question in form ahead of Asco.

text.p: County Tipperary-based trainer Michael Morris said on Friday that his stable-star What A Question is in top form ahead of the Long Walk Hurdle at Ascot, England, on Saturday.

"She's in good form. I expect her to run a good race," Morris said. "She travelled over on Thursday and has had no problems...I will travel across on Saturday." What A Question (11-4) will be ridden by Graham Bradley.
She faces five opponents including Jimmy Fitzgerald-trained Trainglot (7-2), the mount of Richard Dunwoody, over the three miles, one furlong and 110 yards contest at Ascot.
What A Question and Trainglot have already met twice this season and the score stands at one apiece.
